entry.title: Blood Routes
entry.summary: 351 people died in 15 days during the 2026 Eid-ul-Fitr rush. Bangladesh's roads kill at six times the official count. The joma incentive system, political shields, and four critical data voids make it structural — not accidental.

entry.title: The Lead Belt
entry.summary: Bangladesh's lead poisoning crisis mapped: 294 contaminated sites, 145 school–site intersections (121 unique schools) within 500 metres, and soil lead readings up to 1,702 times the international safety standard.
